notes.title: AoP Winter Update
notes.content:
Hey all, we made a small update to AoP. 
- [b]New factions[/b] (mostly the much requested AI factions + the Santa Claus faction) 
- fixes for some of the achievements (sorry!)
- [b] a totally new faction unlock system (no more rubies!)[/b]
- and some visual enhancements.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10611005/3bc3a259250f8ad9f4648da4984fe8b99e7fb0c3.png[/img]

AoP Winter Changelog:

1. Factions
 	- completely new winter/Christmas themed faction added
 	- 4 AI factions added as playable factions (plague, dark warriors, wildlings, shadow demons)


2. Ruby unlock system removed
 	- you can progress on the map, new map pieces unlock if you beat previous ones
 	- factions can be unlocked by beating specific maps


3. Shop removed from main menu
 	- new menu added: Library, there you can review your unlocked factions


4. Missions:
	- Mission UI changed
	- New winter themed map added


5. Options:
	- Added new button "Delete Save", this will reset everything


6. Balance:
	- 3 new unit traits (huge, tiny, beast) and their matching "slayer" opponents
	- slimes are now considered beasts and are vulnerable to some units
	- other smaller balance changes


7. Misc:
	- UI enhancements for better readability
	- minor visual improvements
	- Cleanse the Lands achievement fixed
	- Rush achievement fixed
	- Overwhelm achievement fixed

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content:
tl;dr; We have fixed a problem with save file creation. 

Some people reported that the game menus overlapping each other and the buttons are unresponsive. This was a side effect of wrong save file creation.

GLHF :)

notes.title: Whoops, sorry!
notes.content:
It seems that there is a problem with creating new savefiles, that makes the game unplayable on some computers. Sadly all the test computers had the savefiles already, so we weren't able to identify this bug before :(

We are very sorry about this issue, and we will fix it ASAP (probably in 24 hours or so).

Sorry again!

notes.title: Army of Pixels patch is live
notes.content:
Sorry for the long delay, we were working on a different project, but finally we were able to finish this content patch. Have fun!

[b]Change log:[/b]

	[list]
		[*]Features:
			[list]
			[*] NEW faction (horror)
			[*] Lot of UI fixes:
				[list]
				[*] Tutorial added to main screen
				[*] NEW faction selection screen
				[*] and a lot of other small stuffs :)
				[*] Settings added to menu:
					[list]
					[*] Music volume control
					[*] SFX volume control
					[/list]
				[/list]
			[*] some balancing the for factions
			[*] a bit smarter AI
			[*] Steam cloud save
			[*] Steam achievements
			[*] Steam trading cards
			[*] Steam emoticons
			[/list]
		[*]Bug Fix:
			[list]
			[*]Elf ranger's arrows animation corrected
			[*]Several fixes in endless mode
			[*]Projectiles now correctly hit the first target
			[/list]
		[*]Removed:
			[list]
			[*]Tree of Life
			[/list]
		[*]Other:
			[list]
			[*]Preload all units to prevent hiccups in game
			[*]If the game is minimized or in windowed mode and it loses focus the game will pause until it's active again
			[/list]
	[/list]

notes.title: Coming soon...
notes.content:
There are big changes on the way, some of them are requested by you, some of them are our ideas to make the game even better. Some upcoming features are hidden by pixels, but others will be shared with you now :)

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list] 
 [*]Elf ranger's arrow animation will be correct if the enemy shoots it 
[/list]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
 [*] Updated main menu UI:
[list]
  [*] In options you can adjust music volume
  [*] In options you can adjust SFX volume
 [/list]
[*] Custom game mode
[*] Faction selection will get a completely new UI
[*] AI will be smarter
[*] Steam Cloud Save
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Steam Trading Cards
[*] Steam Emoticons
[/list]

[b]Some features we are thinking about:[/b]
The list below is just some ideas, so maybe not all of them will be implemented
[list]
 [*] Story mode (with real story)
 [*] Terrain modifiers
 [*] Remove ruby unlock system
 [*] Unit upgrades
 [*] More factions
 [*] More terrain
 [*] Rearrage minions in the book between turns
[/list]

The update will be out as soon as we implemented and tested all features.
